quotes.text: QSF16. Relazione di parentela RICODIFICATA NELLA VARIABILE RUOLOFAM
RUOLOFAM Ruolo in famiglia  Unipersonale 1  Genitore in coppia 2  Monogenitore 3  Coniuge senza figli 4  Figlio 5  Figlio di monogenitore 6  Altro 7
• Si prende cura dei figli e/o di altri familiari non autosufficienti 3|_|
Tali stime si riferiscono a tutti i componenti delle famiglie residenti in Italia al netto dei membri permanenti delle convivenze (ospizi, brefotrofi, istituti religiosi, caserme, ecc.) .

assessments.reasoning: The instrument records relationship data via QSF16 recoded into individual family roles (RUOLOFAM). It does not record member-to-member relationships using a matrix or pointer IDs (member_to_member_relationships is false). Extended ties like grandparent-grandchild, siblings, non-kin, or same-sex partners are not explicitly categorized, as non-core relationships are merged into 'Altro' (extended_ties is false). The supplied documents mention household residence but do not state criteria for separating multiple households sharing a dwelling (multiple_household_criteria is false). While RUOLOFAM captures individual roles (e.g., monogenitore, figlio), the documents do not establish that secondary family nuclei or sub-units within a household can be formally identified or linked (sub_units is false). Questions such as QC29 record caring for children or non-self-sufficient relatives as a reason for part-time work or inactivity, but do not record specific caregiving relationships mapping who cares for whom (caregiving_relationships is false).
